script.speaker: roxy
script.text: ok. biked home a different way and found a whole market that opens at 9. we're going.

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: strings of lights, like fifty food stalls. i'm already putting my shoes on

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: a night market?? i'm in. lunch crew is officially a dinner crew!

script.speaker: liam
script.text: food at 9pm? say less. i'm in

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: LIAM. the famous liam. brooke says you've never once turned down food

script.speaker: liam
script.text: hi roxy! it's true. it's kind of my whole thing

script.speaker: maya
script.text: confession: i've wanted tacos for three straight days and said no every single time because of the trip fund. i have been so brave

script.speaker: liam
script.text: tacos at a night market?? maya, that's not a confession, that's a plan

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: TACOS. let's do it!!

script.speaker: liam
script.text: wait. is this the market with the mystery noodle stall?

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: maybe?? it's huge. i got lost twice

script.speaker: liam
script.text: noodle hunt another night. tonight belongs to maya's tacos

script.speaker: maya
script.text: thank you. but i mean it about the fund. one-dollar-sign stalls only. the coast trip is not paying for itself

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: how close are you?

script.speaker: maya
script.text: close enough that one fancy taco would set me back. cheap, or i'm sitting on the curb watching you all eat

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: cheap tacos, done! we're eating at 9 and i'll be sleeping on whatever i eat. light and fresh, please

script.speaker: liam
script.text: and i'm piling cheese and crema on mine. all of it

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: ooh same, cheese on every... wait. no. dairy and i broke up, and it was NOT a clean breakup

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: so no cheese, no crema, no milk anything for me. good thing liam said it out loud

script.speaker: liam
script.text: ok, cheese is off. dairy-free tacos for the table. i'm not making you watch

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: look at us, planning. roxy, lead the way

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: shoes are ON. assistant, pick our stall. go go go!!
